text:
Alex (Sales): Quick heads-up — large fintech prospect wants a POC next week. Main asks: customer-managed keys (no Redwood KMS), HSM-backed key material, key rotation policy (daily rotations with 7-day grace), and audit log export to their SIEM. Any blockers?

Maria (Solutions): Noted. They want to host keys in their Azure Key Vault HSM cluster (BYOK/HSM). Do we have a standard flow for integrating with external KMIP/HSM or Azure Key Vault? Also need pricing delta for Dedicated + BYOK.

Jon (Eng): We support Azure Key Vault (via Key Vault REST + managed identity) and raw KMIP/HSM bridges for Private deployments. For Hosted we currently offer envelope encryption with customer CMKs via a KMS proxy — but HSM-on-customer-network for Hosted is a blocker. For Dedicated/Private we can run a KMIP bridge or an HSM proxy in their VPC.

Jon (Eng): Quick config we used recently:
```yaml
kms:
  mode: kmip-proxy
  endpoint: kmip://10.0.12.4:5696
  auth: client-cert
  rotation:
    strategy: staged-rotate
    window_days: 1
    retention_days: 7
```

Priya (Security): Two redlines from their security questionnaire: (1) explicit proof/cert for FIPS 140-2/3 HSM for key storage, (2) key-escrow policy — they require split custody with 2-person authorization for any emergency key export. We need Legal/Security to approve split-custody process and attestation. Also they want KMS rotation logs exported to their Splunk via syslog and 365-day retention for audit logs.

Maria (Solutions): For pricing: if they want Dedicated with HSM bridging we should add a monthly HSM integration surcharge + one-time SOW for on-site cert exchange and testing. @Alex can you confirm anticipated throughput so we can size Dedicated capacity and estimate cost of rotation impact?

Alex (Sales): Throughput estimate: 500 req/s steady, spikes to 1k for ~10m. They want 99.9% SLA. I'll ask for the Splunk collector host and the list of individuals authorized for key requests.

Jon (Eng): Operational notes: daily rotation of master keys will be heavy if you re-encrypt at rest; we recommend envelope encryption where we rotate the data-encryption keys (DEKs) and keep the master key operations limited. Need to tune cache TTLs and KV cache invalidation so clients don't get auth failures during rotation windows. Also we must coordinate rolling restart of inference workers when we swap HSM certs.

Priya (Security): Also confirm their key export/escrow escalation workflow and retention for export-request logs. We'll need an executed Addendum for split custody and an OPSEC checklist for HSM cert exchange. If they demand offline key ceremony, that adds logistics for SOW.

DeployBot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/sow/PRJ-9087 — added tasks: 'KMIP bridge infra', 'HSM cert exchange', 'SOW pricing addendum', 'Splunk syslog integration'.

Maria (Solutions): Next steps: Alex to get Splunk endpoint + their STO contact; Jon to draft a minimal SOW snippet with integration steps and a list of infra changes; Priya to draft security signoff template and sample split-custody policy. Reconfirm proposed POC start 2026-04-01 (two-week runway).

Alex (Sales): On it, will update by EOD. :thumbsup:
